episode01_shots.action: The crew see Troy in ruins, board their actual vessel, and cast off.
episode01_shots.consequence: We leave Troy behind and establish why the men are sailing.

episode01_shots.action: The vessel leaves the quay; real oars and rudder propel it into the sea.
episode01_shots.consequence: The men are now travelling toward Ithaca.

episode01_shots.action: Penelope looks to the empty horizon while the ship is away.
episode01_shots.consequence: Cut unmistakably to the separate place where someone waits.

episode01_shots.action: Conflict draws reinforcements; men flee into the ship and it withdraws.
episode01_shots.consequence: The first losses force a retreat.

episode01_shots.action: A sailor eats fruit and forgets his task; Odysseus physically leads him away.
The men cross the real threshold, enter the cave and discover stored food.
episode01_shots.consequence: They are inside when the owner returns.

episode01_shots.action: The one-eyed giant and his flock come through the same passage; men recoil.
episode01_shots.consequence: Show his scale next to the humans before introducing the boulder.

episode01_shots.action: Polyphemus grips and pushes a boulder bigger than the portal, closing the entire opening.
episode01_shots.consequence: The interior darkens; both crew and sheep have no exit.

episode01_shots.action: The giant drinks, sleeps, is blinded, moves the stone and the men escape beneath rams.
episode01_shots.consequence: The escape succeeds by changing the condition of the single blocked entrance.

episode01_shots.action: Odysseus shouts his identity from the departing ship; Polyphemus appeals to Poseidon.
episode01_shots.consequence: The god's curse threatens the voyage home.
